answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 29325 Country: India Title: Is bahishti zewar enough to make ones namaz 100% correct according to fardh & sunnah? Any more advice for making my namaz best. Question: Assalaamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullaahi wa Baraktuhu! Respected pious scholars, Is bahishti zewar enough to make ones namaz 100% correct according to fardh & sunnah? Any more advice for making my namaz best.JAZAKALLAH KHARIAN! Answer ID: 29325 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 176/130/L=1432) Yes, Bahishti Zewar too, is enough to offer salah according to fardh and sunnah. You should do zikr extensively in order to remove doubts and fears and to bring full dedication in your salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
